name: Sankat Mochan Hanuman
text:
AUM Sri Hanumate Namaha
Sankat Mochan Bhoot Pisach Vinnashan
Raksha kuru kuru swaha.
meaning: AUM, salutations to Sri Hanuman. Reliever of troubles, destroyer of ghosts and evil spirits: protect, protect, so be it.
purpose: Protection from ghosts and evil spirits, as a devotional practice.
note: The full protection formula as Sarvakali gives it, in Sanskrit and Hindi together. A spiritual practice; where fear or distress is heavy, please also reach out for support.
source: Sarvakali’s teaching (her guru’s version); not a published text
language: Sanskrit and Hindi (in Roman letters, as given)
pronunciation: AUM shree ha-nu-ma-tay na-ma-ha; san-kat mo-chan bhoot pi-shaach vi-naa-shan; rak-sha ku-ru ku-ru svaa-haa
